question: Who became the first male field athlete to win the Laureus World Sportsman of the Year award in April 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Armand Duplantis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Armand "Mondo" Duplantis**, representing **Sweden**, was honored as the **Laureus World Sportsman of the Year** in **April 2025**.
 
• He achieved a historic milestone by becoming the **first male field athlete** to win this prestigious global award since its inception.
 
• The award recognized his unprecedented dominance in the **Pole Vault** event throughout the **2024** season, where he consistently broke his own **World Record** and secured the **Gold Medal** at the **Paris Olympics**.
 
• During the qualifying period, Duplantis pushed the boundaries of human achievement, clearing a height of **6.26 meters**, further cementing his legacy as one of the greatest athletes in history.
 
• His victory broke the long-standing trend of the award being predominantly won by athletes from **Tennis**, **Football**, or **Formula 1**, highlighting the rising profile of **field events** in international sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Laureus World Sports Awards:**

 
 
• Established in **1999** by founding patrons **Daimler** and **Richemont**, these awards are often referred to as the "**Oscars of Sport**."
 
• The first ceremony was held in **2000** in **Monte Carlo**, with **Tiger Woods** being the inaugural winner of the Sportsman of the Year title.
 
• Winners are selected by the **Laureus World Sports Academy**, a jury comprising over **70 sporting legends**.
 
 
 
• **Jakob Ingebrigtsen:**
 
 
• A **Norwegian** middle-distance and long-distance runner who specializes in the **1500m** and **5000m**.
 
• He won the **Olympic Gold** in the **5000m** at the **2024 Paris Games** and holds multiple **European** and **World** records in distance running.
 
 
 
• **Neeraj Chopra:**
 
 
• The "Golden Boy" of **India**, who is a specialist in the **Javelin Throw**.
 
• After winning **Gold** at the **Tokyo 2020 Olympics**, he secured a **Silver Medal** at the **2024 Paris Olympics** and has been a frequent nominee for Laureus awards due to his massive impact on **Asian athletics**.
 
 
 
• **Max Verstappen:**
 
 
• A **Dutch** racing driver who competes in **Formula 1** for **Red Bull Racing**.
 
• He has won multiple consecutive **World Drivers' Championships** (**2021, 2022, 2023**) and previously won the **Laureus World Sportsman of the Year** award in **2022**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The **2025 Laureus Ceremony** celebrated the best of **2024**, which was an **Olympic year**, making the competition for the top honors exceptionally high among global icons.
 
• The distinction between **track athletes** (runners) and **field athletes** (jumpers/throwers) is significant in athletics history; Duplantis's win is a rare recognition for the **jumping disciplines**.
 
• Duplantis holds both the **Indoor** and **Outdoor** world records, making him the most decorated **Pole Vaulter** in the modern era, surpassing the records of legend **Sergey Bubka**.
